text: Assumption: The function is reentrant and thread-safe — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The function is reentrant and thread-safe — is this correct?
norm: the function is reentrant and thread safe
assumption: The function is reentrant and thread-safe.
rationale: The specification is silent on concurrency; since Span views are stateless, reentrancy is obvious.

original.text: Annahme: Reentranz und Thread-Sicherheit — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Die Spezifikation schweigt zur Nebenläufigkeit; da Span-Views zustandslos sind, ist Reentranz naheliegend.
